---
title: "Spells and callbacks"
description: "Create spell objects once and put their logic behind callbacks."
---

```lua
local WGG, warden = ...

local spells = {
  Execute = warden.SpellHandler.NewSpell(163201),
  MortalStrike = warden.SpellHandler.NewSpell(12294)
}

spells.Execute:callback(function(spell)
  local target = warden.UnitManager:Get("target")
  if target and target.enemy and spell:castable(target) then
    return spell:cast(target)
  end
end)

warden.SpellHandler.PopulateSpellbook(spells, "WARRIOR", 1, "Warden Basic")
```

`callback` stores the decision. `execute` invokes the callback during the routine. `castable` checks whether the spell may be used, while `cast` attempts the actual cast. See the [spell reference](/reference/spells) for range, charges, cooldown, and AoE helpers.
